rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (12 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spinout_(soundtrack), https://www.discogs.com/release/1633870-Elvis-Presley-Spinout. Original LP RCA Victor LPM/LSP 3702 (Oct 1966), 12 tracks. Tracks 10-12 ('Tomorrow Is a Long Time' — Dylan cover, 'Down in the Alley', 'I'll Remember You') are bonus tracks recorded outside the film sessions. 'Smorgasbord' is printed 'Smörgåsbord' on some labels.
